landing.how.title: Exam prep in three steps
landing.how.body: Search by your syllabus, pay in one tap, then study only the topics that matter.
landing.how.find.title: Find
landing.how.find.body: Use your university, department and course code (e.g. CSE-2203) to find a course for your exact syllabus.
landing.how.pay.title: Buy
landing.how.pay.body: Pay with bKash, Nagad, Rocket or card. The course opens as soon as payment is confirmed.
landing.how.learn.title: Learn
landing.how.learn.body: 5–15 minute lectures, solved past questions, notes and mock tests.
landing.exam.title: Exam Mode organises the last few days before your exam
landing.exam.body: Add your exam date — you get a day-by-day plan with the teacher's ⭐ important topics first, and the last day kept for revision.
landing.exam.b1.title: Countdown and readiness
landing.exam.b1.body: Days left and how ready you are — from lectures, mock tests and flashcards.
landing.exam.b2.title: Past questions, grouped by year
landing.exam.b2.body: With solutions, so you see the pattern.
landing.exam.b3.title: Flashcards and 30-minute mock tests
landing.exam.b3.body: Mistakes are shown by chapter so you know what to revisit.
landing.exam.b4.title: Night-before revision pack
landing.exam.b4.body: Unlocks the day before — just formulas and key points.
landing.teach.title: Good at explaining your subject? Build courses for students
landing.teach.body: Choose which university, semester and batch it's for. Publish after verification and withdraw to bKash/Nagad/bank.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.q1.q: What if there's no course for my university?
landing.faq.q1.a: Post on the course request board. Teachers see requests with more votes, and you'll be notified when a course is published.
landing.faq.q2.q: How do I pay? What if money is deducted but the course doesn't open?
landing.faq.q2.a: With bKash, Nagad, Rocket or card. Our server verifies the payment with the gateway itself and re-checks automatically if anything gets stuck.
landing.faq.q3.q: What can you see when I connect Google Classroom?
landing.faq.q3.a: Only your classes, assignments, your own submission status, materials and announcements — read-only. Disconnecting deletes all cached data.
landing.faq.q4.q: Do courses guarantee what will be in the exam?
landing.faq.q4.a: No. Teachers highlight likely important topics — that's not a guarantee. Covering the full syllabus is always safest.
landing.faq.q5.a: Yes — within 48 hours of purchase if you've watched less than 20% of the course.
